what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Australia, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 9909 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Australia list floods, storms, wildfires, erosion and mass movements.
UCDP records one armed conflict for Australia: an interstate armed conflict with Iraq in 2003.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced above zero.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Australia.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
